006package gov.nist.secauto.metaschema.core.metapath.function.regex;
007
008import gov.nist.secauto.metaschema.core.metapath.IErrorCode;
009import gov.nist.secauto.metaschema.core.metapath.MetapathException;
010
011import edu.umd.cs.findbugs.annotations.NonNull;
012import edu.umd.cs.findbugs.annotations.Nullable;
013
014/**
015 * MPRX: Exceptions related to regular expression processing in Metapath
016 * functions.
017 */
018public class RegularExpressionMetapathException
019    extends MetapathException {
020  @NonNull
021  private static final String PREFIX = "MPRX";
022  /**
023   * the serial version UID.
024   */
025  private static final long serialVersionUID = 1L;
026  /**
027   * <a href=
028   * "https://www.w3.org/TR/xpath-functions-31/#ERRFORX0001">err:MPRX0001</a>:
029   * Raised by regular expression functions such as <a href=
030   * "https://www.w3.org/TR/xpath-functions-31/#func-matches">fn:matches</a> and
031   * <a href=
032   * "https://www.w3.org/TR/xpath-functions-31/#func-replace">fn:replace</a> if
033   * the regular expression flags contain a character other than i, m, q, s, or x.
034   */
035  public static final int INVALID_FLAG = 1;
036  /**
037   * <a href=
038   * "https://www.w3.org/TR/xpath-functions-31/#ERRFORX0002">err:MPRX0002</a>:
039   * Raised by regular expression functions such as <a href=
040   * "https://www.w3.org/TR/xpath-functions-31/#func-matches">fn:matches</a> and
041   * <a href=
042   * "https://www.w3.org/TR/xpath-functions-31/#func-replace">fn:replace</a> if
043   * the regular expression is syntactically invalid.
044   */
045  public static final int INVALID_EXPRESSION = 2;
046  /**
047   * <a href=
048   * "https://www.w3.org/TR/xpath-functions-31/#ERRFORX0003">err:MPRX0003</a>: For
049   * functions such as <a href=
050   * "https://www.w3.org/TR/xpath-functions-31/#func-replace">fn:replace</a> and
051   * <a href=
052   * "https://www.w3.org/TR/xpath-functions-31/#func-tokenize">fn:tokenize</a>,
053   * raises an error if the supplied regular expression is capable of matching a
054   * zero length string.
055   */
056  public static final int MATCHES_ZERO_LENGTH_STRING = 3;
057  /**
058   * <a href=
059   * "https://www.w3.org/TR/xpath-functions-31/#ERRFORX0004">err:MPRX0004</a>:
060   * Raised by <a href=
061   * "https://www.w3.org/TR/xpath-functions-31/#func-replace">fn:replace</a> to
062   * report errors in the replacement string.
063   */
064  public static final int INVALID_REPLACEMENT_STRING = 4;
065
066  /**
067   * Constructs a new exception with the provided {@code code}, {@code message},
068   * and {@code cause}.
069   *
070   * @param code
071   *          the error code value
072   * @param message
073   *          the exception message
074   * @param cause
075   *          the original exception cause
076   */
077  public RegularExpressionMetapathException(
078      int code,
079      @Nullable String message,
080      @Nullable Throwable cause) {
081    super(IErrorCode.of(PREFIX, code), message, cause);
082  }
083
084  /**
085   * Constructs a new exception with the provided {@code code}, {@code message},
086   * and no cause.
087   *
088   * @param code
089   *          the error code value
090   * @param message
091   *          the exception message
092   */
093  public RegularExpressionMetapathException(
094      int code,
095      @Nullable String message) {
096    super(IErrorCode.of(PREFIX, code), message);
097  }
098
099  /**
100   * Constructs a new exception with the provided {@code code}, no message, and
101   * the {@code cause}.
102   *
103   * @param code
104   *          the error code value
105   * @param cause
106   *          the original exception cause
107   */
108  public RegularExpressionMetapathException(
109      int code,
110      @Nullable Throwable cause) {
111    super(IErrorCode.of(PREFIX, code), cause);
112  }
113}
